tab.teamMatchesHint: Opens all matches of the team.

team.title: Matches
team.locked: The team is read-only, so no new match can be created.
team.emptyMessage: You will see matches here once your captain creates one.
team.emptyStaff: Create the first match: a pitch, a day and a time are enough.
team.missingMessage: This team was deleted or you are no longer on it.

create.title: Create match
create.staffOnly: Only the captain and co-captains can create matches.

form.venueSearchHint: Type a few letters of the pitch name.
form.venueNone: No pitch matches this search. You can also type the pitch yourself.
form.venuePickHint: Selects this pitch for the match.
form.termsFrozen: The match was locked once, so format, slots and fee no longer change. You can still change the day, time and pitch.
form.feeHint: Each player's share follows the number of confirmed players.

validation.venueRequired: Pick a pitch from the guide or type it yourself.
validation.venueTextTooShort: The pitch needs at least {{min}} characters.
validation.venueTextTooLong: The pitch can have at most {{max}} characters.
validation.venueTextInvalid: The pitch cannot contain invisible characters.
validation.searchTooShort: Type at least {{searchMin}} characters to search.
validation.searchTooLong: A search can have at most {{searchMax}} characters.
validation.searchInvalid: A search cannot contain invisible characters.
validation.dateInvalid: Write the day as DD.MM.YYYY, for example 25.10.2026.
validation.timeInvalid: Write the time as HH:MM, for example 21:00.
validation.startsInPast: The match must be in the future.
validation.slotsInvalid: Slots must be a number from {{slotsMin}} to {{slotsMax}}.
validation.feeInvalid: Write the fee in lira, for example 1500 or 1500.50.

detail.missingMessage: This match was deleted or you no longer have access to it.

rsvp.title: Your answer
rsvp.waitlistNotice: The squad is full, you are on the waitlist. When someone drops out, the next player on the waitlist moves into the squad automatically.
rsvp.lockedNotice: The match is locked. You can only answer "I'm out" now.
rsvp.startedNotice: The match has started; your answer no longer changes.
rsvp.closedNotice: This match no longer takes answers.

mvp.title: Player of the match
mvp.hint: Voting closes on {{date}}. The result shows once voting ends.
mvp.question: You are voting for {{name}}. A vote cannot be changed later.
mvp.voted: You voted for {{name}}. The result shows once voting ends.
mvp.notEligible: Only players who played the match can vote.
mvp.none: No player of the match was chosen.

manage.title: Manage match
manage.playedQuestion: The match will be marked as played and the 24-hour MVP vote starts. This cannot be undone.
manage.deleteQuestion: This draft will be deleted. Are you sure?
manage.cancelQuestion: The match will be cancelled and participants notified. This cannot be undone.

lineup.title: Lineup
lineup.empty: No confirmed players yet. The lineup is built from confirmed players.
lineup.editHint: Pick A, B or bench for each player. Nothing is sent until you press save.
lineup.readOnly: The captain and co-captains set the lineup.

payments.title: Payments
payments.membersOnly: Payment details are visible to team members only.
payments.noMoney: No money moves inside the app; this only marks who has paid their share.
payments.notWritable: Payments are marked once the squad is locked.
payments.selfByCaptain: The captain marks your own payment.
